requirements.title: The listed procedure categories are simple procedures
requirements.definition: A simple procedure is an intrinsic procedure specified simple, a module procedure specified simple, a procedure defined by a simple subprogram, a dummy procedure or procedure pointer specified simple, a type-bound procedure bound to a simple procedure, a deferred type-bound procedure whose interface is simple, or a statement function defined in a simple subprogram.

pending.specified-simple-intrinsic-is-simple: PENDING source-use plan: use a clause 16 intrinsic specified SIMPLE in a context requiring simple and observe the exact intrinsic result credited to that intrinsic catalogue.
pending.specified-simple-module-procedure-is-sim: PENDING positive source-use plan: module procedure declared SIMPLE returns exact integer 81 in a context requiring simple.
pending.simple-subprogram-defines-simple-procedu: PENDING positive source-use plan: SIMPLE integer function f(n) returns n+1 and is used by a SIMPLE caller, expecting exact 82 from n=81.
pending.dummy-procedure-specified-simple-is-simp: PENDING positive source-use plan: SIMPLE subroutine apply has SIMPLE dummy procedure op; passing SIMPLE inc changes integer sentinel -82 to exact 82.
pending.procedure-pointer-specified-simple-is-si: PENDING positive source-use plan: procedure pointer declared SIMPLE => inc is invoked from a SIMPLE function and returns exact 83.
pending.type-bound-to-simple-procedure-is-simple: PENDING positive source-use plan: type-bound SIMPLE procedure value returns exact component 84 through a dispatching call.
pending.deferred-type-bound-simple-interface-is-: PENDING source-control plan: abstract parent deferred binding has SIMPLE interface and extension override preserves SIMPLE, returning exact 85.
pending.statement-function-in-simple-subprogram-: PENDING source-use plan: statement function inside SIMPLE subprogram computes exact x+1 with x=85 and no host/common variable reference.

requirements.title: Simple procedures are pure and may also be elemental
requirements.definition: A simple procedure is also a pure procedure subject to the constraints for pure procedures, and a simple procedure can also be an elemental procedure.

pending.simple-procedure-is-pure: PENDING positive source-use plan: SIMPLE function inc(n) is called in a PURE caller and returns exact 91 for n=90, proving simple supplies purity.
pending.simple-subject-to-pure-constraints: PENDING source-control plan: SIMPLE subprogram control obeys 15.7 pure constraints; companion violating C15107 is credited to C15107 rather than this paragraph.
pending.simple-elemental-admitted: PENDING positive source plan: ELEMENTAL SIMPLE integer function inc(n) maps integer array [1,3] to exact [2,4], with target initialized to [-7,-9].

pending.required-simple-interface-not-simple-rej: PENDING diagnostic/control pair: rejected program keeps the explicit interface for g but omits SIMPLE; control adds only SIMPLE.

requirements.title: Simple subprograms do not contain use-associated or host-associated variable designators except constant specification inquiries
requirements.definition: A simple subprogram shall not contain a designator of a variable accessed by use or host association, except as part of a specification inquiry that is a constant expression.

pending.simple-specification-inquiry-control: PENDING conforming control: host scope declares nondeferred CHARACTER(5) variable h; internal SIMPLE function uses LEN(h) only as the constant specification inquiry for local CHARACTER(LEN=LEN(h)) buffer and returns exact LEN(buffer)==5.

accounting.rationale: Defines categories that are simple procedures.
Classifies simple procedures as pure and admits elemental simple procedures.
Simple-subprogram classification and introduction to following constraints are split into fine units.
Defines simple subprograms by the SIMPLE prefix.
Introduces the numbered constraints that follow; no independent semantic obligation beyond those constraints.

review_rationale: Source registration for 15.7 (pure procedures), 15.8 (simple procedures), 15.9 and 15.9.1-15.9.3 (elemental procedures) (batch237). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; C1592-C15121 had no existing tests and carry conforming one-feature diagnostic plans, only their coarray alternatives are out of scope, and elemental semantics are exact. Source accounting only.
